user.title: Add a Raspihats board
user.description: Pick the I2C-HAT to add. Add each board on the stack separately. I2C has to be enabled on the Raspberry Pi first.

address.title: {board} address
address.description: The address set by the board's address jumpers. With no jumpers fitted, a {board} answers at {default}.

error.bus_unavailable: The I2C bus /dev/i2c-1 is not available. Enable I2C on the Raspberry Pi, reboot, then try again.
error.no_response: No board answered at this address. Check the address jumpers and that the board is seated on the header.
error.wrong_board: The board at this address reports itself as "{found}". Pick that model, or check the address jumpers.

abort.already_configured: A board at this address is already set up.

init.title: Board settings
init.description: Everything except the polling interval is stored on the board itself, so it keeps working when Home Assistant is not running. Only values that change are written to the board.

data.safe_on: Outputs switched ON when the watchdog trips
data.safe_hold: Outputs that keep their state when the watchdog trips

data_description.poll_interval: How often the board is read. Inputs that change and change back between two reads are not seen; the edge counters still count them.
data_description.watchdog_timeout: If the board hears nothing from Home Assistant for this long, it switches its outputs to the safe state below. 0 turns the watchdog off. Note that a restart of Home Assistant that takes longer than this also trips it.
data_description.safe_on: All other outputs switch OFF when the watchdog trips, except the ones that keep their state.
data_description.safe_hold: These outputs ignore the watchdog and stay as they were.
data_description.power_on: The state the outputs take when the board powers up, before Home Assistant is running. All other outputs start OFF.
data_description.inverted_inputs: The board inverts these inputs before anything else, so their state and edge counters follow the inverted signal.

error.watchdog_too_short: Use 0 (off), or at least {minimum} s and {polls} times the polling interval, so a few slow polls do not trip it.

abort.not_loaded: The board has to be online to change its settings. Check that it answers, then try again.

wrong_board.message: The board at {address} reports itself as "{found}", not a {board}. Check the address jumpers, or remove this entry and add the board again.
